title: Labby Dispatch Success Envelope
description: Structured content returned by a Labby builtin service tool on success. Advertised as that tool's MCP outputSchema. Error results are deliberately excluded: the ecosystem treats isError results as exempt from outputSchema conformance by convention (this is NOT explicit spec text), and Labby's completed-error envelope is separately schema-locked at docs/contracts/schemas/agent-error.schema.json, which rewraps rather than preserves a tool's success shape. Scope caveat: builtin service tools are suppressed from tools/list whenever Code Mode is enabled, so this schema reaches clients only in Raw mode (server_logs excepted).

ok.description: Always true on the success branch. The error envelope carries ok: false and is not described by this schema.

service.description: Name of the service tool that answered the call. Equals the MCP tool name.

action.description: Resolved dotted action, e.g. `gateway.list`. Includes the built-in `help` and `schema` actions.

data.description: Action-specific payload. Deliberately unconstrained: one tool serves many actions, so a tool-level schema cannot express per-action shapes. No machine-readable per-action result schema exists today.
